notes.title: "THE FURTHEST DISTANCE"Listing Announcement
notes.content:
The crowdfunding demo for 'The Furthest Distance is rushing towards you! 

The crowdfunding demo for FloatGamingStudio's new game 'The Furthest Distance' will soon be available to everyone! If there are no special circumstances, the expected time is before mid June 2025 or even earlier. The crowdfunding demo will showcase the game's prologue plot and some unique gameplay features, making it easier for you to better understand this 2D side scrolling Metroid Castlevania game. The game will only have a crowdfunding user communication group in QQ: 744265669. You are welcome to participate in the discussion and provide valuable suggestions!

Current Development Plan: 

From now to mid June 2025:
Debugging demo, collecting suggestions from internal testing users;

From mid June to mid July (or August) 2025:
Open demo public beta and MoDian crowdfunding, all players can experience the content of the prologue  that has been updated  for free.

If the crowdfunding was successful——
The project will continue to develop according to the original plan. By around 2026, users participating in crowdfunding will have the opportunity to experience the full process demo first;

If the crowdfunding failed——
The project is still very likely to continue, but the full version release time may be extended - (may have to wait until mid-2026?) 

If you are interested in 'The Furthest Distance' or have anything to say to us - join the communication group now! We can't wait to chat with you about these delightful ideas.


浮动游戏 FloatGamingStudio
Jan 22th, 2025(GMT+8)
